attributes.name: legal text placement
attributes.definition: Where small-print legal or disclaimer text is positioned on the page relative to other components.

values.definition: Legal disclaimer sits directly beneath a form.
Legal text is placed in the footer or a standalone bottom line.
Legal text appears elsewhere or is absent.

attributes.name: legal line separator style
attributes.definition: How individual items within a legal or footer line are visually separated.

values.definition: Items separated by vertical bar characters.
Items separated by middle dots or bullets.
Items separated only by spacing, or no separator.
